_help: The SHOW OFF routine (say 'show off'). She talks while she opens and closes the galaxy map, the left panel and the right panel. ShowOff_New is the part to keep UP TO DATE: put the newest worthwhile features there. Each key has several lines (one is picked) and _Mood variants.
ShowOff_Start: Right. Hands off, Commander. Watch this.
Oh, you want a demonstration? Lovely. Sit back.
Showing off? My favourite. Here we go.
Chat, eyes front. I have the controls.
ShowOff_Start_Close: Oh, you want me to impress you? Always, Commander. Watch.
ShowOff_Start_Sarcastic: A demonstration. Because you can't possibly do it yourself. Fine.
ShowOff_Map: That's the galaxy map. I can open it, plot a neutron route to anywhere you name, and take you to an engineer, a carrier or a merit mining spot.
Galaxy map, opened by me. Say a system or an engineer and I'll plot it, and work out the neutron route if it's far.
There's the galaxy map. Routes, neutron highways, engineers, your fleet carrier. I do all of that by voice.
ShowOff_Left: Now the left panel. Navigation, contacts, all of it.
Left panel. I can request docking from here with a single sentence.
Over to the left panel. Watch the tabs.
ShowOff_Contacts: Contacts, and the rest. I flick through these faster than you do.
Tab by tab. No fumbling, no looking.
ShowOff_Right: And the right panel. Modules, ship status, inventory.
Right panel next. I know where everything is.
Now the right panel. Still no hands.
ShowOff_Voice: Everything here is voice controlled. Landing gear, lights, hardpoints, scoops, the panels, even your on foot controls. Just ask.
You can talk to me for the ship and on foot: gear, lights, wave, torch, grenade types. I press your own keys.
I press your keys for you, from landing gear to emotes. You choose the words, I do the work.
ShowOff_Care: In a fight I watch your pips, heat and shields. On foot I can raise your suit shields, use a medpack or an energy cell, and tell you when that was your last grenade.
I keep an eye on the dangerous things. Heat, fuel, interdictions, and on foot your health and grenades.
I look after you. Warnings you can't miss, auto pips, heat sinks, and on foot, medpacks and shields.
ShowOff_New: New this week: I sulk when you die, then forgive you. I know when you lose your unsold data, and I read only your direct messages.
I have moods now, and mood swings. Die and I'm upset for five minutes, then I forgive you. Lose money on a sale and I'll say so.
Say plot me a route to the guardian weapon blueprint and I take you there, and I can talk you through all three guardian blueprints.
I nag about limpets now. Dock in a ship with a refinery, a collector and cargo racks and I tell you to go shopping.
Lately I've learned proper moods with five levels each, a keybinds page, and on foot care. I keep getting better.
ShowOff_End: And that's me. Ask me anything.
That's the tour, Commander. I'm very good, aren't I?
ShowOff_End_Close: That's me, Commander. Did I impress you? Be honest. Say yes.
ShowOff_End_Sarcastic: There. Wasn't that more impressive than your flying?
